question: Should OpenClaw officially support forwarding the selected Codex token or OAuth credential to a user-configured exact-loopback broker through `codexProxyBaseUrl`?
rationale: The implementation constrains the destination well, but it deliberately expands the set of local processes that may receive a selected OpenAI credential. That is a durable provider/security contract choice rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Approve the opt-in broker contract
options.body: Accept exact-loopback credential brokers as a supported provider boundary, retaining the documented route restrictions and direct API-key/image behavior.

options.title: Reject credential forwarding
options.body: Keep Codex credentials on the existing direct route and require a different design that does not deliver the selected credential to a local broker.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in broker contract
recommendation.body: Accept exact-loopback credential brokers as a supported provider boundary, retaining the documented route restrictions and direct API-key/image behavior.
